## Text normalization

Here we map:
- **URLs** to `[URL]` (`http(s)`, `www`, protocol-relative `//…`, then scheme-less `domain.tld/…`),
- **email-like** substrings to `[EMAIL]`,
- **@mentions** to `[USER]`,
- `mbc20` requests to `[MBC20]`

Whitespace is collapsed before substitution.

```{python}
#| label: preprocess-text
#| message: false

import re

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

from utils import Data

_EMAIL_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b",
    flags=re.IGNORECASE,
)
_MBC20_RE = re.compile(r'\{\s*"p"\s*:\s*"mbc-20".*?\}', re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_URL_HTTP = re.compile(r"https?://\S+", re.IGNORECASE)
_URL_WWW = re.compile(r"\bwww\.\S+", re.IGNORECASE)
# Not the // in http:// or https:// (negative lookbehind on the colon)
_URL_PROTO_REL = re.compile(r"(?<![:/])//\S+", re.IGNORECASE)
# Scheme-less host/path: bit.ly/foo, docs.python.org/3/tutorial/… (must include /path).
# Runs after email so addresses like a@b.com are not split at b.com/.
_URL_BARE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?!www\.)(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}(?:/[^\s\[\]<>]*)+",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def normalize_series(text: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Vectorized: URLs (incl. scheme-less) and other placeholders.

    Order matters: ``http(s)`` and ``www`` first, then ``//host``, then ``@`` emails,
    then bare ``host.tld/…`` (second pass for scheme-less links), then mentions and MBC20.
    """
    s = text.fillna("").astype("string")
    s = s.str.strip()
    s = s.str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_URL_HTTP, "[URL]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_URL_WWW, "[URL]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_URL_PROTO_REL, "[URL]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_EMAIL_RE, "[EMAIL]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_URL_BARE, "[URL]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(r"(?<![\w])@\w+", "[USER]", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(_MBC20_RE, "[MBC20]", regex=True)
    return s

data = Data().load("clean")

data.posts["normalized"] = normalize_series(data.posts.post)
# data.posts["post_length"] = data.posts.normalized.str.len()
# data.posts["word_count"] = data.posts.normalized.str.split().str.len()
print(f"Normalized dataset ready: {data.posts.shape}")

data.comments["normalized"] = normalize_series(data.comments.content)
# data.comments["post_length"] = data.comments.normalized.str.len()
# data.comments["word_count"] = data.comments.normalized.str.split().str.len()
print(f"Normalized comments ready: {data.comments.shape}")
```

```{python}
#| label: preprocess-dictionary


def make_dictionary(text: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Whitespace-split word counts pooled across all rows (descending by count)."""
    s = text.fillna("").astype("string")
    tok = s.str.split().explode()
    tok = tok[tok.str.len() > 0]
    return tok.value_counts().rename_axis("word").reset_index(name="count")


original_posts_df = make_dictionary(data.posts.post)
normalized_posts_df = make_dictionary(data.posts.normalized)

original_comments_df = make_dictionary(data.comments.post)
normalized_comments_df = make_dictionary(data.comments.normalized)
```
